# `scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/make_pkdgrav3_par.py`

Source: [make_pkdgrav3_par.py](../../../../scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/make_pkdgrav3_par.py)

Write the pkdgrav3 parameter file of a pipeline run from the variables of its config (environment).

usage: make\_pkdgrav3\_par.py &lt;out.par&gt;   (called by job\_sim.pbs after sourcing the config)
IC\_FILE set (non-empty): read the ICs from that file instead of generating them (Z\_START must be its redshift).
One output per entry of OUT\_Z; STEPS[i] steps from the previous output (or Z\_START) to OUT\_Z[i].
